newsitem.title: UK: Reuters - 3000 orders better than expected.
newsitem.headline: Reuters - 3000 orders better than expected.

text.p: News and information group Reuters Holdings Plc said on Tuesday orders for its new 3000 range of products were coming in faster than expected but installations were slower.
In a statement, chief executive Peter Job said the company's major initiative in 1996 had been the launch, on schedule, of the 3000 range.
"Orders are proceeding faster than expected at 14,700 though installations, at 2,500, are slower."
Reuters said it expects the rate of installations will pick up as it accumulates "solutions to various integration questions going forward".
It noted that some installations aim at a high level of integration with customers' own dealing room technology and that this requires a high level of cooperation with subscribers.
The company said that to gain critical mass it had restructured its pricing to encourage conversions to the 3000 range from the current 2000 series.
Reuters announced that pretax profits for 1996 rose 17 percent to 701 million stg.
